oppyconnect.title: OppyConnect
oppyconnect.summary: Messenger of the LinkBiz ecosystem, published on the App Store and Google Play.
oppyconnect.problem: The platform needed its own conversation channel, with media, documents and voice, without relying on third-party apps.
oppyconnect.solution: I built the app in its entirety: one-to-one and group chat, media and document sharing, voice messages and search.
oppyconnect.impact: A complete app in production on both stores, maintained by me end to end.

linkbiz.title: LinkBiz
linkbiz.summary: AI-powered networking and business-opportunity platform for iOS and Android.
linkbiz.problem: A growing product with continuous demand for new features without giving up stability and security.
linkbiz.solution: I work on the development team: new features, bug fixes and security items, from the front-end to the AWS back-end.
linkbiz.impact: Steady delivery on a production app with real users.

duo.title: Duo
duo.summary: MCP bridge between two Claude Code instances: a Tech Lead delegates work to an Executor on another machine.
duo.problem: A single agent cannot hold the tech lead's overview and the hands on a project living on another machine at the same time.
duo.solution: MCP servers on both sides, networking over Tailscale, local semantic cache, task delegation and a publish barrier via protected branches.
duo.impact: A working agent-to-agent flow with real risk containment in Git.

telegram.title: claude-telegram-bridge
telegram.summary: Self-hosted bridge that pings you on Telegram when a Claude Code session finishes and lets you continue it from the chat.
telegram.problem: Long agent sessions meant sitting at the computer just to know when they ended or needed a decision.
telegram.solution: Per-OS binaries, long-polling with no public server, multiple projects and users on one bot, hooks installed automatically.
telegram.impact: Published with per-OS releases; a two-step setup.

vscode.title: VS Code Extensions
vscode.summary: AI Diff Tracker and Mini Browser, published on the VS Code Marketplace.
vscode.problem: AI agents change many files at once; seeing what changed in real time is hard.
vscode.solution: AI Diff Tracker visually shows the edits agents make as they happen. Mini Browser adds a side browser with tabs, bookmarks, history and an audio mode.
vscode.impact: Two public extensions on the Marketplace, built for my own daily workflow.

about.title: Product end to end, from the app in the store to the database.
about.p1: I'm a FullStack Developer based in São José dos Campos, Brazil. Today I'm a Junior Developer at CDT Software, working on React/Vite front-ends, AWS-hosted back-ends and PostgreSQL databases. Before that I interned at SESI on internal systems, automation and infrastructure.
about.p2: I like shipping the whole product: the published app, the API behind it and a well-modelled database. Lately I build tooling that makes AI-agent workflows (MCP, Claude Code) usable day to day.
about.p3: Degree in Systems Analysis and Development from Faculdade de Tecnologia Senai Félix Guisard. Also: OOP and Databases with Java/SQL (Coursera) and Cybersecurity Defense Analyst (Cisco, in progress). Intermediate English.

who.q: Who is Victor Augusto Ferreira dos Santos?
who.a: Victor Augusto Ferreira dos Santos is a full-stack developer in São José dos Campos, Brazil. He works at CDT Software on apps published to the stores and AWS back-ends, and maintains open-source tooling for AI-agent workflows.

work.q: Where does Victor Augusto work and with which technologies?
work.a: He is a Junior Developer at CDT Software. Day to day he uses TypeScript, React and React Native, Node.js, PostgreSQL and AWS; in personal projects, MCP and the Claude Code ecosystem.

remote.a: Based in São José dos Campos, Brazil. Experience with an on-site team at CDT Software and with remote projects.

opensource.q: Which open-source projects does Victor Augusto maintain?
opensource.a: Duo (an MCP bridge between two Claude Code instances), claude-telegram-bridge and two VS Code extensions: AI Diff Tracker and Mini Browser.

duo.q: What is Duo (an MCP bridge between two Claude Code instances)?
duo.a: A pair of MCP servers linking two Claude Code instances: a Tech Lead delegates tasks to an Executor on another machine, over Tailscale, with a local semantic cache and publishing only through protected branches.

telegram.a: A self-hosted bridge that pings you on Telegram when a Claude Code session finishes and lets you keep replying from the chat. It uses long-polling, needs no public server and ships per-OS binaries.
